description: A grand, double-height open-plan living room with a warm, contemporary luxury aesthetic. The focal wall behind the seating area is clad in rich vertical slatted walnut wood paneling from floor to ceiling, framing a wide-format flat-screen television and a linear gas fireplace set into a low travertine stone surround and shelf. The travertine surround has a warm creamy beige tone with natural veining. Flanking the wood wall, to the right, tall sheer white curtains diffuse bright natural daylight flooding in from a large floor-to-ceiling window wall. To the left, an open-plan kitchen is partially visible through the double-height space, with white flat-front cabinetry and marble countertops. The flooring throughout is large-format light grey or cream stone tile. The seating group consists of two generous cream upholstered sofas facing each other across a travertine or stone coffee table with an organic rounded double-lobe form on two short cylindrical pedestals. A single small bud vase with dried stems and a stacked book or two sit on the coffee table surface. A large low-pile area rug in a subtle grey geometric pattern anchors the seating area. Charcoal grey square throw cushions punctuate the cream sofas. The room has tall double-height ceiling space. Warm light from the ceiling fixture spills over the seating arrangement below. Camera is at standing or slightly elevated eye-level, approximately 5–6 feet, shooting a three-quarter corner view that captures the full seating area, the fireplace wall, and the kitchen opening. Wide lens encompassing the generous room depth. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
